the GLPI can be a good indicator for measuring the green logistics efficiency of a country.

the relationship between the LPI and EPI.
the relationship between green logistics and the environment, which is an important issue in today's business world, especially with the growing awareness of environmental sustainability.
the relationship between logistics efficiency and environmental quality.
